correctness.rationale: The exact source identity is normalized by the source Fourier convention. The multiplier 1/xi has kernel (i/2) sign(x), so mean-zero data are sent to i times their primitive. The Hermitian self-pairing is twice the primitive curve algebraic area. Periodic Wirtinger plus Cauchy--Schwarz gives the sharp signed-area bound L^2/(4 pi), and equality forces a once-traversed circle. Source-compatible annular approximation passes the regularized identity to the stated class and yields the missing half-Sobolev component.

value.rationale: Appendix A is presented as the canonical one-dimensional Hilbertian model of the source cancellation mechanism, but its quantitative estimate hides the constant. The new result identifies the cancellation functional exactly as curve area, finds the optimal constant, and classifies all equality cases. This is a structural and extremal completion of the model estimate and clarifies why the self-pairing is stronger than a generic endpoint operator bound.
